findings.title: OpenSSH Server regreSSHion Remote Code Execution (openssh-server)
findings.description: Race condition in sshd signal handler on glibc-based Linux systems allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root.
findings.remediation_hint: Upgrade openssh-server via apt-get to patched Ubuntu 22.04 LTS security release and verify sshd service health.

findings.title: OpenSSL SSL_select_next_proto Buffer Overread Vulnerability (openssl)
findings.description: Calling SSL_select_next_proto with an empty supported client list can trigger a buffer overread.
findings.remediation_hint: Upgrade openssl and libssl3 packages to latest patched Ubuntu 22.04 LTS release.

findings.title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled (PermitRootLogin yes)
findings.description: The PermitRootLogin parameter in /etc/ssh/sshd_config is currently set to 'yes', violating CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark 5.2.10.
findings.remediation_hint: Backup /etc/ssh/sshd_config, set PermitRootLogin no, validate syntax with /usr/sbin/sshd -t, and reload sshd.

findings.title: Windows TCP/IP IPv6 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
findings.description: Integer underflow in Windows TCP/IP stack processing crafted IPv6 packets allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
findings.remediation_hint: Install Microsoft Security Update KB5041578 (or newer) or disable IPv6 on non-essential interfaces via registry/NetAdapterBinding.

findings.title: Ensure SMBv1 protocol is disabled on Server service
findings.description: Registry key HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters\SMB1 is missing or enabled (non-zero), exposing legacy SMBv1 attack surface.
findings.remediation_hint: Export registry backup via reg.exe, set HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters\SMB1 = 0 (DWORD), and disable SMB1Protocol feature.

findings.title: curl ASN.1 date parser out-of-bounds read vulnerability (Homebrew curl)
findings.description: Vulnerable Homebrew curl version installed under /opt/homebrew/bin/curl allows out-of-bounds read when parsing crafted ASN.1 certificate dates.
findings.remediation_hint: Upgrade Homebrew curl package cleanly without touching SIP-protected /usr/bin/curl.

findings.title: Ensure macOS Application Firewall is enabled
findings.description: Application Firewall globalstate in /Library/Preferences/com.apple.alf.plist is currently disabled.
findings.remediation_hint: Backup /Library/Preferences/com.apple.alf.plist and enable firewall via /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on.

findings.title: Ensure Gatekeeper and System Integrity Protection (SIP) / MDM Profile Policy is enforced
findings.description: Security control is governed by Apple System Integrity Protection (SIP) and corporate MDM Configuration Profile lock; local shell scripts cannot override SIP or MDM-managed payloads.
findings.remediation_hint: Blocked by Apple SIP/MDM. Enforce via corporate MDM Configuration Profile (.mobileconfig) and verify manually on device.
